semiconductor_relevance: High — SIEGERT WAFER GmbH supplies silicon wafers and substrates, which are fundamental materials in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: SIEGERT WAFER GmbH is a supplier of silicon wafers and various substrates, including SOI wafers, Fused Silica, Borofloat, glass, and sapphire, catering to universities, research labs, and industrial clients. They offer customized substrate solutions and wafer processing services, emphasizing R&D with advanced metrology tools for precise characterization.
capabilities: Supply of silicon wafers and SOI wafers
Provision of Fused Silica, Borofloat, and sapphire substrates
Wafer processing services including grinding and polishing

regional_presence.Europe: Headquartered in Aachen, Germany, serving clients across Europe.
